summary: The per-edition wiki coverage report (edition_coverage: Living sources, the lane counters, the soak window and the bundle) writes the lane's counts as it makes them, from its full rows: editions run, with pages seen, with a text, walk complete; pages seen; the editions' own article counts; the full-text range as the report's bounds; gaps; newest event time; no edition code. A sum no edition could give is unknown, never 0; the upper text bound is unknown unless every part is known; an unreadable last event is counted apart. K13 lists wiki as a lane block (no new K id); the KPI GET never opens the lane. Row 184 complete.
